## CI/CD Status
<!-- The automated workflows will run automatically -->
The following workflows will run automatically:
- 🔧 **Backend CI**: Builds and tests the ASP.NET Core API
- 🎨 **Frontend CI**: Builds and tests the Angular application
- 📱 **Mobile CI**: Validates the React Native mobile app
- 🔗 **Integration Tests**: Tests Docker Compose orchestration
- 📊 **Code Quality**: Runs linting, formatting, and security scans

Please ensure all checks pass before requesting review.
